payload.title: DIP-B01: Reduce semantic management overhead observed in the controlled pilot
payload.description: The controlled six-pair gpt-6.1-sol/high pilot passed all 48 functional cases in both arms, with all contract fields and deferred features retained. Median workflow time was 164.19 s for a Markdown baseline and 360.84 s with DIP; input/output usage increased. DIP emitted 134 MCP calls in 12 scored turns. Full evidence: docs/benchmarks/model-controlled.md. Investigate redundant reads, fragmented intent/claim/checkpoint operations and excessive management output. No causal attribution to one component is established. This task is future improvement work; no runtime optimization was made during the experiment.
acceptance: Profile actual management sequences from the retained trial evidence before choosing an optimization.
Reduce redundant management round trips or payloads while preserving ownership fencing, future backlog, durable intent and snapshot-based verification.
Repeat the same preregistered matched scenarios against the optimized implementation and report all outcomes/costs, including regressions.
